title: Welcome to Taipo
body:
Taipo automates the tedious parts of being an Amazon Associate or Influencer — pulling your clicks, orders, and earnings from Amazon, tracking Creator Connections campaigns, and running it all on a schedule so you don't have to check manually.

To get started: open Settings and enter your tracking IDs (Associates Base ID, Influencer Onsite ID, Storefront URL). Then head to Add Tasks & Features and set up your first task — ready-made cards for pulling earnings, tracking clicks, or auto-accepting Creator Connections campaigns. Each task can run on demand or on its own schedule, and everything it collects shows up on your Dashboard Home, which you can customize to show what matters most to you.

Questions or feedback? There's a Feedback page in the sidebar — we read every submission.
